topic: Use number bonds to add three single-digit numbers
rationaleNote: One method sheet: the finished 7 + 5 + 3 drawn in the board's own counters, with the three success-criteria steps copied word for word and pinned to the counters they act on, kept for the rest of this 16-lesson addition and subtraction unit (the view names no later lesson, so the pointing moment is any later lesson that adds three digits in one go, such as a column with a carried 1). The any-order fact and its 4 + 2 + 6 counters were left off as a second sheet, because the worked example already shows it in use by adding 7 and 3 before the 5.

items.label: Step 1
items.text: Find two numbers that are a {{number bond}} to 10. They might not be next to each other.
